description.en: Read DSH replies aloud with Microsoft neural voices (Xiaoxiao, Yunxi, …) through a local edge-tts service: read the selection, read from here to the end, or read the whole reply, with voice and speed switching and same-origin streaming playback. Unreadable text is skipped instead of replayed, and browser speech takes over when the service is unavailable.
description.zh: 用微软神经网络语音（晓晓、云希等）朗读 DSH 的回复：可朗读选中、从当前读到结尾、或整条回复，支持切换音色与语速，同源流式播放；读不出来的内容自动跳过不重读，服务不可用时退回浏览器语音。
